title: ShowInFolder
description: Request: the folder that holds an item, with that item selected. Shares listFolder's channel, so either one ends the other with cancelled (latest wins). The reply is a folderListing with selected, or the folder error listFolder would send for the item's folder; a drive or share root has no containing folder and is folderNotFound.

path.description: The item's path, file or folder, normalized by the engine as listFolder's path is.
